title: 运行时数据区与内存池：从 MemoryPoolMXBean 看堆/非堆划分
expected_output:
=== runtime data areas (as seen by MemoryPoolMXBean) ===
heap pools     : [G1 Eden Space, G1 Old Gen, G1 Survivor Space]
non-heap pools : [CodeHeap 'non-nmethods', CodeHeap 'non-profiled nmethods', CodeHeap 'profiled nmethods', Compressed Class Space, Metaspace]
=== heap usage sanity (absolute numbers are machine dependent) ===
committed > 0            : true
max > 0                  : true
used <= committed        : true
=== collectors ===
collectors : [G1 Concurrent GC, G1 Old Generation, G1 Young Generation]
GC names contain 'G1' : true
